en.t: “It is not really deep in the mountains or anything.”

units.source_text: 千重子戴着手套就去握住苗子的双手，说，

en.t: Chieko, still wearing her gloves, took Naeko’s hands in hers and said,

units.source_text: “真高兴啊，打夏天以后就再没见过面啦。

en.t: “I am so happy. We have not seen each other since summer.

units.source_text: 那次在杉山里，太感谢你了。”

en.t: Thank you so much for what you did that time on Mount Sugi.”
